item.title: ISSS Town Hall: Duration of Status (D/S) Changes
item.description: ISSS is holding a Town Hall to share information about the recent regulatory change to Duration of Status (D/S) that affects individuals in F-1 and J-1 status and their dependents. This event is open to the campus community, and this session focus is on answering student questions. Join us virtually on Thursday, August 13, 2026, from 10:00 a.m. to 11:00 a.m. Register here: https://tinyurl.com/RPI-DS-townhall
item.author: Community

item.title: All Instructors - Changes for Submitting a LMS Fall 2026 Course Request
item.description: Note - Please read the entire announcement as there are changes in submitting a request due to moving to Ultra Course View. You can find Ultra Videos and documentation on our LMS support site. Instructor’s can now copy your own content from a previous semester’s course, that’s still on the LMS, into your current semester’s course, as long as you were/are the instructor in both semester courses.

item.title: Updates to the student experience
item.description:
As we prepare for the year ahead, you are invited to join us for a campus-wide conversation about updates designed to support and strengthen the student experience on August 19 from 9–11 a.m. at CBIS, Auditorium.

For information about sharing your news or events, or to change your subscription settings, visit morningmail.rpi.edu.
